items.author: r3nt.bsky.social
items.context: Was finally able to play stardew valley without problems. Blue light glasses? New monitors? Who knows. Anyway, back to fishing.
items.text: Glad it feels comfortable now. Enjoy the fishing!

items.author: monsterteatime.bsky.social
items.context: What your favorite Stardew Valley season songs? Mine is the Winter theme, it's like a trancey synth, slightly melancholy. My kiddo hums it all the time as stimming.
items.text: Love that your kiddo hums it. A slightly melancholy winter theme sounds just right for a cozy game.

items.author: daisybellthecow.bsky.social
items.context: Does anyone else make an intense routine out of their comfort games? I'm realizing that the way I play Tomodachi Life is like I'm a computer program. But it's such a relaxing and stabilizing part of my day. Even the way I feed the residents is full of if/then statements. No randomization.
items.text: A routine you can count on is a big part of what makes a comfort game comforting. Sounds like a calm part of your day.
